method: Median of two trial medians (five repetitions each) for M1, Zen4 (when supplied), Zen5 and GNR; one historical trial of five repetitions for V2 and V3. Each case weighted equally in geometric means; all logical workload counters match. ARM identical binaries, x86 same historical C++ source with per-target tuning. Zen4 adds only its compiler tuning name to the historical CMake build configuration. Dollar indices divide the measured single-thread index by allocated core price, relative to V3. Intel uses two billed vCPUs per physical core. Mac primary model allocates cost over 8 cores; alternate allocation uses 4. Eight means listed cores (four P plus four E), four means P cores only with no E-core throughput credit. Both reuse M1 Pro timing for unmeasured base-M1 rental; neither measures host scaling.
